title: Job: God's Majesty Is Unsearchable

questions.question: How have you helped him who is without what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:2 (ESV): "How you have helped him who has no power! How you have saved the arm that has no strength!"

questions.question: With whose help have you uttered what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:4 (ESV): "With whose help have you uttered words, and whose breath has come out from you?"

questions.question: The dead tremble under the waters and their what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:5 (ESV): "The dead tremble under the waters and their inhabitants."

questions.question: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:6 (ESV): "Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering."

questions.question: He stretches out the north over the void and hangs the earth on what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:7 (ESV): "He stretches out the north over the void and hangs the earth on nothing."

questions.question: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:8 (ESV): "He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not split open under them."

questions.question: He has inscribed a circle on the face of the waters at the boundary between what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:10 (ESV): "He has inscribed a circle on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness."

questions.question: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astounded at his what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:11 (ESV): "The pillars of heaven tremble and are astounded at his rebuke."

questions.question: By his power he stilled the sea; by his understanding he shattered whom?
questions.explanation: Job 26:12 (ESV): "By his power he stilled the sea; by his understanding he shattered Rahab."

questions.question: By his wind the heavens were made fair; his hand pierced the what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:13 (ESV): "By his wind the heavens were made fair; his hand pierced the fleeing serpent."

questions.question: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:14 (ESV): "Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways, and how small a whisper do we hear of him!"

questions.question: But the thunder of his power who can what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:14 (ESV): "But the thunder of his power who can understand?"

questions.question: He covers the face of the full moon and spreads over it his what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:9 (ESV): "He covers the face of the full moon and spreads over it his cloud."

questions.question: Whose spirit has come out from you?
questions.explanation: Job 26:4 (ESV): "...and whose breath has come out from you?" implies questioning the source of the friend's speech.

questions.question: How have you counseled him who has no what?
questions.explanation: Job 26:3 (ESV): "How you have counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!"

key_verse_text: He stretches out the north over the void and hangs the earth on nothing.
